title: Bagah Hub Gakuran Keyless
features:
BAGAH HUB - GAKURAN

VERSION 0.6.0
PLAYER

- Target Lock - Floating list to lock onto a player. Combat focuses only on the locked target.
- Auto Respawn - Respawn automatically when dead .
- Ignore Friends - Auto Parry, Auto Fight, and Face Lock skip Roblox friends.
- No Dodge Cooldown - Remove the local dodge cooldown so Q can be spammed.
- Dodge Cooldown - Set a custom delay between dodges (0 = instant).
- No Combat Slowdown - Keep WalkSpeed from dropping while attacking.
- Infinite Jump - Jump again in mid-air.
- Auto Sprint - Sprint without holding Shift.
- WalkSpeed Modifier - Override WalkSpeed while Speed Hack is on.
- Enable Speed Hack - Force WalkSpeed to the modifier value.
- Fly - WASD flight with adjustable speed.
- No Clip - Walk through map collisions.
- Anti Fling - Disable collision with other characters so fling exploits cannot launch you.
- Teleport to Player - Select and teleport to any player.
- Teleport to Location - Select and teleport to saved map locations.


COMBAT

- Perfect Auto Parry - Automatically parry detected attacks.
- Auto Parry Keybind - Toggle Auto Parry with a hotkey.
- Animation Sync - Adjust parry timing to the attack animation speed.
- Parry Facing - Turn toward the attacker before parrying.
- Grapple-Aware Combat - React to grapple attacks.
- Auto Punish - Counter after a successful perfect parry.
- Face Lock - Continuously face the selected nearby target.
- Facing Check - Only react to attackers facing your character.
- Parry Settings - Max distance, face target range, parry timing, block hold time, and ping adjust.
- Enable Auto Fight - Automatic M1/M2 combat with a target lock range and separate M1/M2 ranges.
- Auto Fight Keybind - Toggle Auto Fight with a hotkey.
- Mobile Toggle Buttons - On-screen buttons for Auto Parry and Auto Fight.


VISUALS

- ESP: Box, Health Bar, Name & Info, Highlight / Chams, and adjustable ESP distance.
- Player HUD: Draggable health bar and M2 cooldown indicator.


MUSIC GAME RHYTHM

- Rhythm Auto - Automatically plays Gakuran rhythm notes.
- Timing Mode - Always Perfect or Custom Mix.
- Custom Mix Ratings - Configure PERFECT, GOOD, and OK chances.
- Perfect Offset - Apply a configurable early-input offset in milliseconds.
- Hold Extend - Extend long-note holds.
- Hold Release - Tune when long notes are released.


AUTO PIANO

- Online Song Player - Search NanoMidi or load songs from My Songs.
- MIDI Conversion and Playback - Convert supported MIDI songs and play them on Gakuran pianos.
- 61-Key Piano Support - White and black piano notes.
- Chord and Sustain Timing - Simultaneous chords, independent note lengths, and repeated notes.
- Mobile Piano Controls - Draggable floating controls for loading, browsing, playing, stopping, and song info.


HALLOWEEN EVENT

- Auto Trick or Treat - Visits every house door, fires the treat prompt, and stops at the 2000 candy hourly cap. Respects each house's 10 minute server cooldown.
- Auto Toilet Paper (Trick) - Fires each house's  prompt, then throws rolls at the house until it is papered. Shares doors with Auto Trick or Treat, so only one of the two runs at a time.
- Auto Seven Wonders - Finds wonder prompts, accepts the invite, and plays Piano, Stairs, Hanako, Anatomy, Statue, Mirror, Photo, and the Eighth.
- Wonder Picker - Farm any single wonder or let the bot choose.
- Auto Accept Invite - Join the wonder immediately, or only walk to the prompt.
- Wonder Status - School clock, night check, mirror window, current stat
